prompt: # SYSTEM PROMPT — CODING AGENT TASK: "SALT & EMBER" Editorial Landing Page (Complete Build) **Mission:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. CREATIVE BRIEF — "SALT & EMBER — Braised Short Ribs" **0.1 Theme & Art Direction** - Editorial, recipe-driven culinary brand; 2020s Contemporary. Mood: *low heat, long hours, deep flavor.* **0.2 Palette → Token Mapping (all six colors must be used)** - `--bg-primary: #f2e8d8` (cream base — never pure `#ffffff`; use `#fefefe` only if a near-white is truly required). - `--bg-secondary: #e6d9c3` (warm tan surfaces). - `--primary: #d9622b` (ember), `--secondary: #f0a35e` (amber) — accents, gradients, hover shifts. - `--text-primary: #1c1712`; `--text-secondary` derived from `#26201a` (≈72% mix, e.g., via `color-mix(in srgb, …)`). - `#26201a` = deep surface color (footer band, dark hero panels, dark-mode surfaces). - `--gradient-ember: linear-gradient(135deg, #d9622b, #f0a35e)`; `saturate()`/`sepia()` warmth on decorative layers. - **Scroll animation:** `IntersectionObserver` toggles an `.is-visible` class; initial hidden states apply **only** under `html.js` so nothing is lost if JS fails. - **Zero image files:** every visual is CSS-composed — gradients, blurred pseudo-elements, glass layers, Material Symbols, `aspect-ratio` containers. **0.5 Required Sections (one page, in this order)** 1. **Sticky glass header:** wordmark "SALT & EMBER", anchor nav (Features, Method, Table Talk, Pricing, FAQ), theme toggle, "Reserve a Box" button; Fraunces prices, `check`-icon feature lists, "Select" buttons opening the modal (**2.4**). 7. **FAQ:** accessible accordion, 5–6 culinary Q&As (**2.5**). 8. **Final CTA:** full-width glass panel over an ember gradient containing the newsletter form (**2.3**). 9. **Footer:** deep `#26201a` band — brand + tagline, secondary link columns (Recipe Journal, Company, Support), text-chip social links, legal line, back-to-top link.
